# RGCAT

> RGCAT is a reproducible Python toolkit for cluster-based geometry coverage analysis, gap identification, and analytical method comparison in Roboforming process data.

This site currently presents the project’s methods and example outputs. Source code, installation instructions, and detailed documentation will be linked when the repository is released publicly.

## Project

- [RGCAT overview]({{ site.canonical_origin }}/): Project purpose, pipeline, example outputs, release status, documentation scope, and licensing information.
- [MIT License information]({{ site.data.site.docs.official_license }}): The official Open Source Initiative page for the MIT License.
